name: node-addon-require-builtin
description: Valuz stand-in for node-addon-require-builtin (the unrestricted variant dsh uses to reach Node's internal module loader). The upstream addon probes the runtime and only supports Electron 43+, so under the desktop's Electron-as-node it fails closed and no dsh process can boot. This package keeps its API and forwards requireBuiltin(id) to require(id), which Node and Electron both allow when the process runs with --expose-internals — Valuz always launches dsh with that flag. Wired in by the overrides field of ../../package.json; drop it once the desktop ships an Electron the upstream addon supports.
